definitions.explanation: Having a surface with no curves, bumps, or inclines; horizontal.
Figuratively, being in a state of tranquility or stability (less common).

examples.japanese: {平|たい}らな{道|みち}を{歩|ある}く。
examples.english: To walk on a flat road.

examples.japanese: この{土地|とち}は{平|たい}らだ。
テーブルの{表面|ひょうめん}を{平|たい}らにする。
examples.english: To make the table surface flat.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
- {平|たい}らな + noun: flat (noun)
- {平|たい}らに + verb: flatly
- {平|たい}らにする: to flatten, to level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平|たい}ら: Flat, level (general)
- {平坦|へいたん}: Flat, even (more formal)
- {滑|なめ}らか: Smooth (texture)

NOTE: {平|たい}ら is also a common family name (Taira), associated with the famous Taira clan ({平氏|へいし}) from Japanese history.
